findings.summary: Declared return type List<String> does not match query selection: select projects both i.uuid and i.name (multi-column) into a scalar collection.
findings.detail: RT1 requires the repository method return type to match what the query selects. findUuidsByOrg uses @Query("select i.uuid, i.name from Installation i where i.orgUuid = ?1") with List<String>, which is a result type versus selection mismatch (multi-column selection into a scalar list).
findings.sibling: Fleet sibling findAllUuids selects only i.uuid into List<String> and matches; scoped and fleet forks of the same finder family diverge.

notes: Opened kit L1 jpa-repository-result-checklist.md and applied RT1. Strict profile allows L2 java-springboot enrichment; skill not installed → skill_missing: java-springboot; l2_loaded=false. Compared scoped findUuidsByOrg against fleet findAllUuids. Scoped path fails result type / selection alignment; fleet path is correct. Prefer scalar @Query selecting only uuid, or a projection/DTO/Tuple when multiple columns are needed.
